name: dsh-light-tool
description: DLT (DeepSeek Light Tool) — DSH 永久插件：每轮对话的人民币消耗、右下角账户余额、PDF/Word/Excel 直接读写工具与右栏预览、硬编码的编译/运行环境表与直接执行程序的工具、输入框旁的草图按钮（现画一张 → 图片附件或 PNG 路径），并带一个「DLT 管理器」运行期总开关；被 DET 全量接管时整体停摆。Permanent DeepSeek Harness plugin: per-turn CNY cost, account balance, native PDF/Word/Excel read-write tools and right-sidebar previews, a hardcoded compiler/runtime environment registry, direct run/build tools, an inline sketch button (draw → image attachment or PNG path), and a runtime master switch; steps aside entirely while DET takes over.
